title: Lahore to Restore Historic Area Using British-Era Techniques
excerpt: The Punjab government is launching a major restoration and beautification project at Lahore's historic Lakshmi Chowk and surrounding areas.
body_html:
The Punjab government has announced a major restoration and beautification project aimed at Lahore's historic Lakshmi Chowk and its surrounding areas.

According to the details, the initiative will utilize British-era construction techniques to revive the traditional aesthetic and structural aspects of the historic location.

Authorities plan to focus on improving the visual appeal and infrastructure of the designated zone through this specialized revival effort.
